card.category: file host (free Lite, paid Pro plans)
card.summary: Free sendspace Lite: files up to 300 MB (split files allowed), no registration needed, ad-supported, kept while downloaded at least once every 30 days.

record.category: file host (free Lite, paid Pro plans)

free_tier.stated: Free sendspace Lite: files up to 300 MB (split files allowed), no registration needed, ad-supported, kept while downloaded at least once every 30 days.

per_object_cap.stated: 300 MB per file on Lite; 5 GB on Pro Base; 10 GB on Pro Plus and Business

retention.stated: a file becomes inactive when not downloaded at least once in a 30 day period; Premium files are not deleted when inactive

egress.terms: Pro Base includes 100 GB of recipient bandwidth a month; Pro Plus 300 GB; Business 500 GB. No free recipient bandwidth figure is published on the pages read.

record.interface_detail: Web upload; a PDF user guide is linked from the FAQ. No API page was read.
record.tooling: Browser upload; no API or client documented on the pages read.
record.chaining: Pro Base is $9 for 1 month (5 GB per file, 100 GB of recipient bandwidth a month); a 12-month Pro Base is $89.

limits.value: 300 MB per file on Lite, split files allowed; 5 GB on Pro Base
a file becomes inactive after 30 days without a download
100 GB of recipient bandwidth a month on Pro Base

record.binding_note: The 300 MB per-file ceiling on the free tier is the first limit; it only moves with a paid plan.

identity_cost.detail: No registration and no email address are needed to upload; registration is optional and free.

record.reliability_note: Long-running host; no status page was read.
record.confidence_note: Limits and prices read on the vendor FAQ and upgrade pages.

evidence.quote: As long as the file size is less than the file size limit (300MB - split files allowed)
evidence.proved: the free per-file limit is 300 MB

evidence.quote: You do not need to register to use ***send*space**.
A file becomes inactive if it has not been downloaded at least once during a 30 day period.
evidence.proved: inactivity is 30 days without a download

evidence.quote: Pro Base 1 Month @ $9 includes 100GB recipient bandwidth a month.
evidence.proved: the cheapest paid plan is $9 for one month with 100 GB of recipient bandwidth

evidence.quote: Upload and send files up to 5 GB each
evidence.proved: Pro Base allows 5 GB per file

record.notes: Cheapest paid tier is Pro Base at $9 for one month.
